mcp.desc: Connect the ChatGPT or Claude you already use, and your AI can directly read your contact data (bookings, questionnaire answers, profile) to help you prepare for meetings. No usage cap.
mcp.endpointLabel: Connector URL (recommended — paste it, log in to Kimaru, and just tap Allow)
mcp.loadError: Could not load the connection URL.
mcp.regenDone: Disconnected all. Connected AI clients are now invalid.
mcp.revokeNote: “Disconnect all” invalidates every connected AI client — you’ll need to reconnect.
mcp.step1Desc: : Settings → Connectors → “Add custom connector”, paste the URL above, then tap Allow.
mcp.step2Desc: : Settings → Plugins → turn on Developer mode → register a new plugin with the URL above, then approve.
mcp.step3Desc: : Once connected, just ask “prepare my meeting with ___”. Your AI reads bookings, answers, and your profile.
